items.name: gold-slither-1
items.prompt: Draw this whole golden horned snake from the side, facing right: its full long body stretched out behind its head in a gentle S-curve lying low on the ground, slithering, the tail tapering to a point on the left. Keep exactly the same head from the picture: the same golden-yellow scales, the two small dark horns, the big shiny brown eye, the red-brown cheek patch and the friendly smile, the same painted storybook style with dark ink outlines. Plain flat grey background, the whole snake in the picture with space around it.
